# gramlot-py-server 0.3.20

- Integrate Kajenn's native WebSocket support with the shared PageStore channel: binders, RPC, publications, owner checks and one connection for the complete window family.
- Expose Kajenn-configured databases through Page/PageStore `db(name)` and `async_db(name)`, using kajenn-db's Asqueel, SQLAlchemy and Django handlers.
- Run synchronous page methods/controllers on the native pool and release database resources on the same worker. Keep explicit transaction control with the application.
- Add a runnable optional Kajenn/Asqueel SQLite customer gallery, plus persistence and Chromium/WebKit family qualification.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.20 or later. PageStore recipes remain synchronous. Django's handler refuses async access; backend feature parity is not implied. Kajenn #89 remains open: cancellation of in-flight asynchronous database I/O is not qualified. The SQLite gallery uses synchronous controllers. Other adapters retain their existing capabilities.
